statement: Regarding Bayesian Optimal Uniform Reserve, we conjecture that there is also no separation between quasi-regularity and regularity in terms of the revenue approximation of Bayesian Optimal Uniform Reserve against Bayesian Optimal Mechanism for asymmetric buyers. To prove this conjecture, one possible approach is to establish a reduction framework (similar to Lemma V.1) from quasi-regular buyers to regular buyers. However, as we observed in Example V.2, for symmetric quasi-regular buyers, there is a strict but bounded separation between quasi-regularity and regularity, and we conjecture that Example V.2 is indeed the worst-case instance.

context: Approximation by Prior-Independent Mechanisms Now we consider the second mentioned topic, Approximation by Prior Independent Mechanisms. The Single-Item Setting. The celebrated Bulow-Klemperer result [BK96] and its extension by [FLR19] (Wisdoms 6 and 7) studied a variant mechanism called 1-Duplicate Second Price Auction: • 1-Duplicate Second Price Auction (SPA⊕1 ): Run Second Price Auction on a new (n + 1)-buyer scenario F × Fi′ ; the new buyer Fi′ = Fi is duplicated from one original buyer i ∈ [n] that is chosen optimally for revenue maximization.16 (Moreover, provided with i.i.d. original buyers, there is no difference in choices of the buyer i ∈ [n] to be duplicated.) Result 7 (Theorem 12). For asymmetric regular buyers or asymmetric quasi-regular buyers, 1-Duplicate Second SPA Price Auction achieves a tight CBOM⊕1 ∈ [0.3817, 0.6365] SPA⊕1 or CBOM ∈ [0.2770, 0.6365]-approximation to Bayesian Optimal Mechanism, respectively. ▷ We conjecture that both tight bounds are the same; suppose so, the “asymmetric quasi-regular” case collapses into the “asymmetric regular” case. Wisdom 6 ( [BK96]). For i.i.d. regular buyers, 1-Duplicate Second Price Auction surpasses Bayesian Optimal MechSPA anism (without duplicates), namely CBOM⊕1 = 1. ▷ Herein, Bayesian Optimal Mechanism degenerates into Bayesian Optimal Uniform Reserve [Mye81]. First, for quasi-regular items, Bayesian Optimal Uniform BOUP Pricing achieves a tight CBODM ≈ 0.3817-approximation BOUP or CBORM ∈ [0.1385, 0.3817]-approximation to Bayesian Optimal Deterministic Mechanism (BODM) or Bayesian Optimal Randomized Mechanism (BORM), respectively.21 Previously such constant revenue guarantees were known only for regular items [CD15], [AHN+ 19], [JLQ+ 19b]. Second, Bayesian Optimal Deterministic Mechanism admits a PTAS for quasi-MHR distributions and a QPTAS for quasi-regular distributions.
